evidence_summary: Amazon PTD carries hazmat/compliance structures, while UN Model Regulations Rev.24 define dangerous-goods classification, listing, packaging, marking and documentation as an international transport-compliance domain. evidence_summary: GS1 Global Data Model distinguishes minimum shelf life at arrival, minimum shelf life from production, and usage period after opening. Google expirationDate is a channel publication/expiry control rather than an exact shelf-life duration, and the frozen five-provider corpus lacks a second exact general shelf-life representation.
lead_note: Track the family so FMCG/beauty is not forgotten, but reject a single shelf_life_days field until lifetime semantics, lot/expiration ownership and exact mappings are resolved.
